title: Collab user count doesn't decrement when a user leaves (stuck at high-water-mark)
description: FIXED. Root cause: useCollabStatus (CollabControls.tsx) derived the status-pill count from y-webrtc's connection-level 'peers' event (Math.max(webrtcPeers,bcPeers)), which has NO TTL — an unclean leave lingered in room.webrtcConns/bcConns forever and never emitted a shrunk array, so the count only ever grew (high-water-mark). Fix: derive the count from the AWARENESS controller (awareness.getStates() minus self via controller.getPeers().length, subscribed via onPeersChange) — the same single source of truth the presence avatars use. Awareness prunes on clean leave instantly (setLocalState(null)) and on unclean drop within ~30s (built-in outdatedTimeout), so the pill now DECREMENTS on leave/disconnect/timeout. Test: src/collab/__tests__/collabStatusCount.test.ts (4 cases: join+graceful-leave up-then-down; ungraceful timeout drop decrement; user's A/B+/B-/C+/C- -> 1/2/1/2/1; churn current-set not high-water-mark). VERIFY: full ordered build green; pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui test --run src/collab -> 1171/1171 passed (99 files), all P2 presence/follow-peer tests green, no regressions.
